ledger.name: absent
ledger.source_assertion: require.False(t, s.Mutes(model.LabelSet{"foo": "bar"}), "expected alert not silenced without any silences")

ledger.name: nonmatching_exact
ledger.source_assertion: require.False(t, s.Mutes(model.LabelSet{"foo": "bar"}), "expected alert not silenced by non-matching silence")

ledger.name: matching_exact
ledger.source_assertion: require.True(t, s.Mutes(model.LabelSet{"foo": "bar"}), "expected alert silenced by matching silence")

ledger.name: expired_exact
ledger.source_assertion: require.False(t, s.Mutes(model.LabelSet{"foo": "bar"}), "expected alert not silenced by expired silence")

ledger.name: future_start
ledger.reason: Scheduled start time is not represented by the native suppression contract.
ledger.source_assertion: require.False(t, s.Mutes(model.LabelSet{"foo": "bar"}), "expected alert not silenced by future silence")

ledger.name: scheduled_activation
ledger.reason: Activation from a future StartsAt requires start-time semantics absent from the native contract.
ledger.source_assertion: require.True(t, s.Mutes(model.LabelSet{"foo": "bar"}), "expected alert silenced by activated silence")

ledger.name: additional_future_regex
ledger.reason: Combines an existing active silence and another future regular-expression silence; multi-silence/start/regex semantics are outside the native contract.
ledger.source_assertion: require.True(t, s.Mutes(model.LabelSet{"foo": "bar"}), "expected alert still silenced by activated silence")

ledger.name: overlapping_regex_activation
ledger.reason: Overlapping silence expiration/activation and regular-expression matching are outside the native contract.
ledger.source_assertion: require.True(t, s.Mutes(model.LabelSet{"foo": "bar"}), "expected alert silenced by activated second silence")

projection: foo exact label equality -> context equality; initial now -> t=3; fixed P0; suppress until now+300; query expiration at now+3600
